title: LibraryDraftDiscardedData
description: Data of the library.draft_discarded event of earlier versions of Gentry: the directory of the shared subagents, then called the library of subagents, is back to its active content. The event has no project; the data is an empty object. Gentry no longer writes it: the draft of the shared subagents is discarded with the flow of a project, by flow.draft_discarded; the journal keeps the events written before.
